title: Speed Round: Over/Under
desc: Quick-fire — is the real number over or under what we say?

questions.q: Over or under: A football pitch is 120 metres long
questions.a: Over in total (including end zones/goal areas it can be 120m), but the field of play is typically 100-110m. So: roughly correct / under for the playing field itself

questions.q: Over or under: Wimbledon has been running for 100 years
questions.a: Over — first held in 1877, making it nearly 150 years old

questions.q: Over or under: An NBA basketball hoop is 3 metres high
Over or under: A marathon is 40 kilometres
Over or under: A boxing round lasts 5 minutes
questions.a: Under — a professional boxing round is 3 minutes (with 1 minute rest between rounds)

questions.q: Over or under: The Tour de France covers 2,000 km total
questions.a: Over — it's typically around 3,400-3,500 km over 21 stages plus rest days

questions.q: Over or under: An Olympic swimming pool is 25 metres long
questions.a: Over — Olympic pools are 50 metres (25m is a 'short course' pool)

questions.q: Over or under: A cricket Test match can last 7 days
questions.a: Under — a Test match is scheduled for a maximum of 5 days (though historically some 'timeless Tests' were longer)

questions.q: Over or under: A Formula 1 car can go from 0-100 mph in 5 seconds
questions.a: Under — modern F1 cars do 0-100 mph in about 2.5 seconds

questions.q: Over or under: There are 50 players on an American football team roster
questions.a: Over — NFL active rosters have 53 players (plus a practice squad)
